overview: The Twilight Sea is Luclin’s great oceanic ring, a vast expanse of water dotted with islands, ruins, siren territories, and elemental anomalies. It is both a travel hub and a dangerous frontier.
history: The Twilight Sea formed naturally around Luclin’s central spire during the moon’s early geological history.
The Combine Empire established research outposts and arcane observatories on several islands.
Siren Courts rose to power after the Combine collapse, claiming dominion over the reefs and deepwater trenches.
Elemental anomalies began appearing after planar instability increased across Luclin.
Mariner clans formed trade routes between islands, navigating the Sea’s unpredictable storms.
regionHooks: A Combine observatory reactivates after centuries of dormancy.
Siren Courts launch raids on mariner trade routes.
Elemental anomalies converge, creating a new island.
A deepwater trench reveals an ancient Combine vault.
Stormbreaker Isles experience unnatural tidal surges.
